shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
sed -n '1,240p' .lore/test-commands.yml
rg -n \"specs/hal-engine-config-hooks|spec:\" src test tests specs --glob '*test*' --glob '*.md' 2>/dev/null | head -160"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md
git diff --check
git diff -- specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md && git commit -m "Align config hooks spec status with coverage" && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
